title: A faithfully flat ring map is universally injective
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a faithfully flat ring map of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-faithfully-flat-ring-map] and $N$ an $R$-module. Then the $R$-linear map $N\to N\otimes_RS$, $n\mapsto n\otimes1$, is injective.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma Tag 05CK (lemma-faithfully-flat-universally-injective), first sentence ('R -> S is universally injective as a map of R-modules') and the first sentence of its proof
